fusions.name: Pressed Flat
fusions.desc: You charge up to 6 tiles to the target and crush it, dealing 18 damage. The target is [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tear a Ream
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Tears a ream from your own body and scatters it, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Shelved Until Spring
fusions.desc: You regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hidebound Volume
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
